title: 1812 jaunts: swinging doors, a sally port, and two new stops
items: Staged people open doors to go in or come out, and the doors swing shut behind them.
The covered-way view sits over a new sally port; the carriers walk out through it, not the pickets.
New battle stops: Black Partridge hands back his medal, and the war party and Billy Caldwell at the Kinzie house.
The Kinzies' green has a gate on each side you can open and walk through.
In the murder jaunt, Kinzie paddles across in his own pirogue, and four soldiers carry Lalime on a bier.
Every staged walk now goes through a gate, never through a fence.
